marks.q: Against this backdrop, we are increasingly confident that our pipeline office schemes at 10 King William Street, EC4, Brettenham House, WC2, and Paddington, W2, all of which are in undersupplied sub-markets with excellent connectivity, will set new benchmark rent levels.
The Period has seen further strong progress across our business, building on the significant momentum delivered in the first half of the year.

The central London office market continues to be characterised by strong occupier demand and a constrained development pipeline, supporting the current and forecast sustained rental growth for best-in-class buildings.

With our development at Delta Paddington now out of the ground and our Southwark PBSA on track to receive Gateway 2 approval this year, we have a clear pathway to generating meaningful and sustainable returns.
Across the development pipeline, we remain on track to deliver both Delta Paddington and 10 King William Street on schedule, with the latter due to reach practical completion in December this year.

lines.text: Southwark PBSA return: Jul-26 “should enable Helical to generate in excess of a 3.0x return on investment” → Oct-26 “expected to generate an attractive return on investment”, no multiple
The Bower occupancy: Jul-26 “increasing occupancy to 96.6%” and WAULT 6.4 years → Oct-26 no occupancy or WAULT figure, while an early surrender of the 1st and 2nd floors of The Warehouse is disclosed
Brettenham House completion: Oct-25 “completion anticipated in summer 2026” → Jul-26 “in September 2026” → Oct-26 “expected at the end of October”
Southwark first payment quantified: Oct-26 “our costs of £5.3m will be reimbursed and we will receive our first profit payment of £10.2m”, on Gateway 2 approval “expected in November”
